messages:
mina: Quick follow-up  Action Item #3 from PM INC-2026-311 (rollout gating for quantized models) is overdue. Owner listed as @paul. Can you share status and new ETA?

paul: Apologies, been blocked on a perf regression in q4_8-bit on A100 farms. I have an investigation branch and a mitigator (fallback to q5) but need infra review. PR: https://git.redwood/infer/pr/5012 (WIP). ETA for review + canary: 48h.

yara: We have a partner demo next week; 48h might be tight. Can you split the mitigator (fallback) into a hotfix so we can land quickly and keep the full perf fix as follow-on?

paul: Good call. I'll split into two PRs: (1) hotfix to enable runtime fallback to q5 when q4_8-bit latency exceeds threshold, (2) perf fix. Will open hotfix in ~30m.

ops-bot: Reminder: Action Item #3 assigned to paul is overdue (due 1812259278). Update tracker: https://tracker.redwood/incidents/INC-2026-311/actions.

paul: Hotfix PR opened: https://git.redwood/infer/pr/5013. Includes a runtime flag and smoke tests. ETA for merge: EOD.

mina: Please include a short note in the PR describing the conditions under which fallback triggers so SRE can tune alerts.

paul: Added trigger doc and test `tests/test_fallback_trigger.py`. CI passing, canary in us-central went green. Merged and updated tracker.

yara: Verified tracker and postmortem updated with a recurrence note about "quantization latency regressions". Closing Action Item #3. :white_check_mark:

mina: Thanks all. Please open the follow-on perf task for visibility and assign to paul. Closing thread. :v:
